name: WONPARA Wars
source: Board strategy game that is a knock-off of Archon. There is a war between a men society and a women society, and you control the male team. Whenever you defeat a female opponent, you get to undress her and use your manly "persuasion" skills to convice her to abandon the fight.
translation: 一款模仿《Archon》的棋盘策略游戏。男性社会与女性社会正在交战，玩家控制男方队伍。每击败一名女性对手，便可脱掉她的衣服，再运用充满男子气概的“说服”技巧，劝她放弃战斗。
